info.description: Gogobackup: storages, backup plans and the accounts that manage them
info.title: Gogo API Template

post.description: Emails a single-use reset link when the address belongs to an account. Always answers 200, so it does not reveal which emails are registered.
Authenticate user with email and password

get.description: Get information about the currently authenticated user

put.description: Update name and email for the currently authenticated user
Change password for the currently authenticated user. Revokes all refresh tokens.

post.description: Sends a new verification link to the current user's email address
Refresh the access token using a valid refresh token
Create a new user account with email and password
Sets a new password with the token from the emailed link. The link works once; all sessions are signed out.
Confirms an email address with the token from the emailed link

get.description: Every storage, without credentials. Admins only.

post.description: Send the block named by kind (local, s3 or gcs) and no other. S3 and GCS need credentials. Admins only.

Writes a small object, reads it back and deletes it. A failed test is a 200 whose step says what failed. On an edit form, pass storage_id so blank credentials are taken from that storage. Admins only.

parameters.description: The storage being edited, whose credentials a blank form uses
parameters.name: storage_id

get.description: A storage without its credentials: secret_set says whether they are stored. Admins only.

put.description: Credentials left blank keep the stored ones, unless the kind changes. Admins only.

delete.description: Removes the storage from Gogobackup. The files in it are not touched. Admins only.

get.description: The folders, then the files, directly under prefix (empty for the top). A storage that cannot be reached is a 502 with the reason in details.reason. Admins only.

parameters.description: Folder inside the storage, such as nightly/2026/
parameters.name: prefix

post.description: Writes a small object, reads it back and deletes it. A failed test is a 200 whose step says what failed. Admins only.

get.description: Paginated list of users with the given role. Admins may only list role "user"; super admins may list any role.

post.description: Create a user with one role. Admins may only create role "user"; super admins may create any role.

put.description: Update name and email of a user the caller is allowed to manage

delete.description: Delete a user the caller is allowed to manage. Cannot delete yourself.

post.description: Set a new password for a user the caller is allowed to manage. Revokes the user's refresh tokens.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
